newsitem.title: USA: University of Wisconsin divests Texaco stake.
newsitem.headline: University of Wisconsin divests Texaco stake.

text.p: The University of Wisconsin is to sell the 11,000 shares it owns in Texaco Inc because of the oil major's participation in a natural gas concession in the Andaman Sea, 125 miles off the Burmese coast.

"Divestment from Texaco is consistent with the current investment policy of striking a balance between getting financial returns and respecting ethics," Jonathan Barry of the university's board of Regents, its governing body, said in a statement.
Texaco holds its annual shareholder meeting on Tuesday and minority rights groups, environmental and human rights campaigners have said they will target the oil company.
Texaco had some 260 million ordinary shares at the end of the first quarter of 1997.
